text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'One dot is one daylight hour at one of six solar plants. The forecasts are day-ahead, and the dots are a random sample of 2,000 hours. The lag is the power at the same clock hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was issued, which is two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast.'
